input.question: What gives a band's music the distinct sound that allows you to identify the band even if you've never heard the song?
input.ground_truth: Musical style, of course. But also the selection of instruments and how they are played. I work as a sound engineer, and there are a few of my friends i can recognize when are playing. And I guess in the same way you might recognize an author through the writing style, you might also recognize the way the music is composed.

Each band has its own special way of making music. Maybe one band always uses a funny guitar sound, or maybe their singer’s voice sounds like a squirrel squeaking! Or maybe they play their instruments in a special way, like clapping your hands fast or slow.

So, even if you don’t know the song, when you hear how the band plays and sings, your brain goes, “Oh! That’s the cookie with sprinkles!” and you know which band it is. That’s what makes their music sound special and easy to recognize.
